levels.name: LANDING ZONE
levels.story: Dawn at the landing zone. Mira's trail leads north through patrols loyal to a warlord called the Brute.

levels.name: THE RUINS
levels.story: Dusk in the old temple. The bridge is out, the fog is thick, and something that used to be a soldier hunts between the pillars.

levels.name: THE OUTPOST
levels.story: Night at Mira's outpost. Gates, searchlights and the Commander's walker stand between Kade and his sister.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Kade, it's Juno. You're on the ground and I'm at a safe altitude, which is my favourite kind.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Mira's last ping came from the research outpost, three klicks north. Follow the trail.

lines.speaker: kade
lines.text: Copy. If my sister's out here, I'll find her.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Checkpoint flag. Somebody left supplies. Don't ask who, just take them.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Hold up. That's a camera in the mud. Kade... it's Mira's.

lines.speaker: kade
lines.text: Footage is half gone. But she's laughing. She's working with them.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Maybe she had no choice. Maybe she did. Keep moving.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Big heat signature past that wall of vines. I'd say knock, but he looks like the door.

lines.speaker: brute
lines.text: Little engineer. The Commander said you would come. He did not say you would be so small.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: That is a very large man with a very large gun. Use the pillars!

lines.speaker: brute
lines.text: Enough! I will bury you in this dirt!

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: He's angry now. Jump the shockwaves!

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: He's dazed! The tank on his back, hit it now!

lines.speaker: brute
lines.text: The Bloom... keeps us... strong...

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: The what now?

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Fog's thick, so I'm flying on instruments and spite. The outpost is past these ruins.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: The mercenaries here carry grenades and fly drones. I'd complain to their manager.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: The bridge is out. There's a patrol boat at the bank with a gun on it. I'm just saying.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: I've been reading the logs you found. The Bloom doesn't just glow, Kade. It gets into people's heads.

lines.speaker: kade
lines.text: And Mira's been growing it.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Something's moving in the temple and my scope can't hold on to it. Careful.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: You hear it too. The humming. It tells me you are a threat.

lines.speaker: kade
lines.text: You're a soldier. You have a name under all that.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: I had... a name.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Kade, his vitals read like a sleepwalker. He isn't choosing this. Maybe don't finish him.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: It says... burn you out.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Gas clouds and drones. Keep moving and stay out of the green.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: He's failing. Watch the red line, then get clear.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: He's down. The humming is fading on my scope. Your call, Kade.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Sergeant... Elias Reyes. That is my name. I remember rain.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Welcome back, Sergeant. Extraction's on me.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Quiet... finally... quiet.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: ...Right. Moving on.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Every soldier he has left is between you and that gate. No pressure.

lines.speaker: kade
lines.text: I didn't come this far to turn around.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: That gate's on a keypad. Find the terminal and I'll talk you through the hack.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Halfway. For the record, I'm proud of you. Don't make it weird.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Courtyard ahead. Something with four legs just powered up. I miss the large man.

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: Engineer. You think I am the villain of this valley.

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: The Bloom keeps men from tearing each other apart. I am guarding it from people far worse than me.

lines.speaker: kade
lines.text: Then you won't mind if I ask my sister.

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: You will have to get past the walker.

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: Shield generator down. Impressive. Irrelevant.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Searchlight! Stay out of the beam or it rains mortars.

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: The core! Keep away from the core!

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: He said the quiet part out loud. Shoot the core!

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: If it falls into their hands... remember that I tried to hold the line.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Kade? You came all this way.

lines.speaker: kade
lines.text: You were working with him.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: I was. The Bloom calms minds. It also keeps this whole valley alive. I thought I could choose which.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: There is a kill switch, and there is a containment seal. I can't decide. You have to.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: There's a third way. The river. I remember the river.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Reyes? The water... it strips the spores and leaves the rest. Kade, he's right.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Riflemen ahead. They like cover. You like them out of it.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Machetes! They're fast and they're loud. Don't let them get close.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Red laser means a sniper is lining you up. Move when the dot stops moving.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Grenadier! A red ring on the ground means leave.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Scout drones. Fragile, annoying, a lot like my ex.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Shield trooper! Bullets bounce off the front, so flank him or shoot the legs.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: You're bleeding all over my rescue. Find cover and breathe.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Vitals are ugly, Kade. Get behind something solid.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Do not die. I already spent the advance.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Three for three. Show-off.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: That's some shooting for a bridge builder.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Remind me never to play darts with you.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: That one parted your hair!

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Too close. Way too close.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Nice dodge. Do that every time.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: They're running out of soldiers faster than I'm running out of jokes.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Remind me to stay on your good side.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Kade? Kade! ...Okay. Back to the last flag. Again.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: No, no, no. Up you get. The flag's still there.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Quiet. I like quiet.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: He never heard a thing. Neither did I, and I was listening.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Intel. I'll add it to the codex.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Another log. Keep them coming.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Got it. Reading while flying. Very safe.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Is that a golden idol? Who hides those in a jungle? Besides everyone.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: You're on the gun. I'd say aim, but it has plenty of bullets.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Stay on the terminal. They will not like this.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Rain's coming in. They'll see less and hear less. So will you.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Lights out. Somebody is going to come and look at that.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Nice shot. Now it's dark for them too.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: He's done, Kade. Hands up means hands up.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Your call. I'm not the one who has to live with it.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: He's running. Good. Let him tell the others what he saw.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: One less man holding a rifle, and nobody had to die for it.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: He had dropped his weapon.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: ...Noted.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: They found one of the bodies. So much for quiet.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Somebody tripped over your handiwork. Expect company.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Storm's coming in. Thunder covers gunfire, if you time it.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Lightning. If you can see them in the flash, they can see you.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Rain. Good for you, it eats footsteps. Bad for my rotor.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: It's coming down. Watch the puddles, they splash.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: That torch of yours can be seen from the next valley.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Light on. Brave. Or tired of sneaking.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Hear that? No birds. They know something is wrong before the soldiers do.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: The jungle's gone quiet. That's on you.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Those birds just told everyone where you are.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Flock's up. Anyone watching the treeline saw that.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: The flamethrower needs a breath. So do I.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Over the top. Show-off.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Three down and nobody has noticed. I'm almost impressed.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: You're good at this. I'm not sure that's a compliment.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: That one parted your hair.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Too close. Move!

lines.speaker: kade
lines.text: She had a place to sleep. She chose not to use it.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: They are losing people out here, Kade, and it isn't to you.

lines.speaker: kade
lines.text: That's her writing. She was measuring it.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Measuring how fast it grows. Or how fast it takes.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Mercenaries, praying. That's new.

lines.speaker: kade
lines.text: They weren't prisoners.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: No. That's the part I don't like.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Whoever pays for this place doesn't want a paper trail.

lines.speaker: kade
lines.text: Mira...

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Keep it together. We're close.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: That's not a prisoner counting days. That's someone who stopped wanting to.

lines.speaker: kade
lines.text: Nobody was calling for help.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Somebody made sure nobody could.

lines.speaker: soldier_a
lines.text: Contact!

lines.speaker: soldier_a
lines.text: Intruder on the trail!

lines.speaker: soldier_b
lines.text: He's here!

lines.speaker: soldier_b
lines.text: There! By the trees!

lines.speaker: soldier_c
lines.text: Eyes on target.

lines.speaker: soldier_a
lines.text: I'm hit!

lines.speaker: soldier_b
lines.text: Agh! Medic!

lines.speaker: soldier_c
lines.text: Armour's holding!

lines.speaker: soldier_a
lines.text: Man down!

lines.speaker: soldier_b
lines.text: They got Ortiz!

lines.speaker: soldier_b
lines.text: Frag out!

lines.speaker: soldier_b
lines.text: Eat this!

lines.speaker: soldier_a
lines.text: Falling back!

lines.speaker: soldier_a
lines.text: Cover me!

lines.speaker: soldier_b
lines.text: Cut him down!

lines.speaker: soldier_b
lines.text: For the Bloom!

lines.speaker: soldier_a
lines.text: Hold still...

lines.speaker: soldier_a
lines.text: Got you in my sights.

lines.speaker: soldier_a
lines.text: Three days of rain. Three.

lines.speaker: soldier_b
lines.text: I didn't sign up to guard a flower.

lines.speaker: soldier_c
lines.text: Quiet tonight. I hate quiet.

lines.speaker: soldier_a
lines.text: He's a demon!

lines.speaker: soldier_b
lines.text: I can't stop him!

lines.speaker: soldier_a
lines.text: Thought I heard something.

lines.speaker: soldier_c
lines.text: Check the bushes.

lines.speaker: soldier_a
lines.text: What was that?

lines.speaker: soldier_a
lines.text: Stay here. I'll look.

lines.speaker: soldier_b
lines.text: Something moved.

lines.speaker: soldier_c
lines.text: Probably nothing. Probably.

lines.speaker: soldier_a
lines.text: Man down! We've got a body!

lines.speaker: soldier_b
lines.text: Ortiz? Ortiz!

lines.speaker: soldier_c
lines.text: He's dead. Sound the alarm!

lines.speaker: soldier_a
lines.text: Don't shoot! I'm done!

lines.speaker: soldier_b
lines.text: I give up! I give up!

lines.speaker: soldier_c
lines.text: Enough. I'm not dying for a flower.

l1_open.caption: Three weeks ago, Dr. Mira Voss stopped answering her radio.
Her brother Kade, an army engineer who builds bridges rather than wars, bought a seat on the only helicopter flying into the valley.
The pilot stayed on the line. She says it is for the money.

l1_close.caption: Mira's camera survived the fight. The last clip shows her handing a sample case to a man in a commander's coat. Willingly.
North of the ridge the jungle swallows an older place. Stone, river and fog.

l2_open.caption: The temple was old before anyone drew a map of this valley.
Something grows here that glows at night. The mercenaries call it the Lumen Bloom.

l2_close.caption: The logs were clear. Spores from the Bloom make people calm, loyal and easy to lead. The Commander has been feeding it to his own men.
And Mira helped him grow it.

l3_open.caption: Mira built the outpost to study the valley. The Commander turned it into a fortress.

end_destroy.caption: Kade throws the kill switch. The Bloom burns white, then grey, then nothing.
Mira flies home beside him. Behind them the valley's rivers run brown and the canopy starts to thin.
The soldiers wake up as themselves, in a jungle that no longer protects them. Some thank him. Some never will.

end_preserve.caption: Kade closes the containment seal. The Bloom keeps glowing behind glass.
Mira stays. The outpost takes down its guns and becomes a sanctuary, and the valley stays green.
Kade leaves alone. The humming follows him as far as the river, and he tells himself it is only the rotors.

end_third.caption: They open the sluice instead. River water floods the grow beds and the spores wash out pale and harmless.
The Bloom survives, smaller and quieter. It heals. It no longer whispers.
Sergeant Reyes carries the first clean cutting out of the valley. Mira and Kade follow, arguing about bridges.

destroy.title: ASHES
destroy.hint: Throw the kill switch. Mira comes home. The valley loses its guardian.

signoff.speaker: juno
signoff.text: You got her out. That was the job. The rest... we'll carry it. Juno out.

preserve.title: SANCTUARY
preserve.hint: Close the containment seal. The valley lives. Mira stays.

signoff.speaker: juno
signoff.text: She chose to stay, Kade. That's not losing her. Probably. Juno out.

third.title: CLEAR WATER
third.hint: Reyes remembers the river. Wash out the spores, keep the cure.

signoff.speaker: juno
signoff.text: Everybody lives and the flower behaves. I didn't know we were allowed to win like that. Juno out.

intel.title: Field note, Dr. M. Voss
intel.text: Specimen LB-1 glows brighter when people are near. It seems to like company.

intel.title: Supply manifest
intel.text: 40 crates rifles. 12 crates 'calming agent (LB extract)'. Signed for by the Commander.

intel.title: Patrol log
intel.text: The Brute has not slept in six days. Says the Bloom hums him lullabies.

intel.title: Voice memo, Mira
intel.text: Kade would hate it here. Too many things he can't fix with a wrench.

intel.title: Lab log 14
intel.text: Subjects exposed to the spores follow simple orders without question. The effect fades nine days after the last exposure.

intel.title: Medical file: Sgt. E. Reyes
intel.text: Volunteered for the 'enhanced reflex' trial. Has stopped answering to his own name.

intel.title: Temple carving, translated
intel.text: The flower keeps the valley. The valley keeps the flower. Do not carry it out. (The order of the levers is carved beside it: SUN, RIVER, MOON.)

intel.title: Mira, private
intel.text: River water neutralises the spores but not the healing compounds. Why has nobody tested this?

intel.title: Commander's log
intel.text: Three buyers have made offers for the Bloom. All three would turn it into a weapon. I refused all three.

intel.title: Outpost order 7
intel.text: Dr. Voss is not a prisoner. Dr. Voss is not to leave.

intel.title: Mira, private
intel.text: He believes he is protecting it. I believed I was studying it. We were both just feeding it.

intel.title: Maintenance note
intel.text: Walker core runs hot with the armour panels off. Do NOT let anyone shoot the core.

idols.title: Idol of the Sun
idols.text: A palm-sized gold figure, warm to the touch. Its eyes glow faintly green.

idols.title: Idol of the River
idols.text: Found behind the temple. Water beads on it and runs uphill.

idols.title: Idol of the Moon
idols.text: The Commander kept it on a shelf. Someone had turned its face to the wall.

bios.title: Kade Voss
bios.text: Former army engineer. Builds bridges, clears roads, fixes generators. Came to the valley for one reason: his younger sister.

bios.title: Juno
bios.text: Former combat pilot, current freelance. Stays on the radio, briefs every level and insists she is only here for the fee.

bios.title: Dr. Mira Voss
bios.text: Botanist. Found the Lumen Bloom, built an outpost to study it, and stayed long after she should have left.

bios.title: The Commander
bios.text: Took over the outpost with a private company of soldiers. Says he is guarding the Bloom. May even believe it.

bios.title: The Lumen Bloom
bios.text: A glowing plant found only in this valley. Its spores calm and bind the mind. Its roots seem to hold the valley's water and soil together.

enemies.title: Rifleman
enemies.text: Moves between cover, strafes and fires short bursts. Falls back when hurt.

enemies.title: Machete Runner
enemies.text: Sprints in a zig-zag and slashes after a short wind-up. Low health, travels in groups.

enemies.title: Sniper
enemies.text: Perches in towers. Shows a red laser for 1.5 seconds before each shot, then relocates if hit.

enemies.title: Grenadier
enemies.text: Keeps his distance and lobs grenades with a two-second fuse. Watch for the red ring.

enemies.title: Shield Trooper
enemies.text: Advances behind a shield that stops bullets from the front. Flank him, shoot his legs, or wait for the baton swing.

enemies.title: Scout Drone
enemies.text: Circles at changing heights, fires laser bursts and dive-bombs. Fragile. Explodes when it lands.

bosses.title: The Brute
bosses.text: A warlord in plate armour with a minigun for an arm. Bait his charge into a pillar, then shoot the tank on his back.

bosses.title: The Phantom
bosses.text: Sgt. Elias Reyes, deep under the Bloom's influence. Cloaks, teleports, throws knives. Can be spared once beaten.

bosses.title: The Commander's Walker
bosses.text: Four legs, a shield, missiles, mortars and a laser. When the armour breaks, the core takes triple damage.

scenes.title: A cold camp
scenes.text: Two bedrolls. One has been slept in. The other is still folded, with M.V. inked on the strap.

scenes.title: Three helmets
scenes.text: Three stakes, three helmets, fresh earth. The soldiers bury their own and do not mark the names.

scenes.title: Survey line
scenes.text: Survey flags in a row, each tagged in Mira's handwriting: soil, water, bloom spread. The last tag only says: faster than last month.

scenes.title: An old shrine
scenes.text: Fresh fruit in a bowl older than the ruins. Somebody still leaves offerings at a shrine nobody admits to visiting.

scenes.title: The quiet ward
scenes.text: Six cots under a tarp. None of these men were wounded. Every chart says the same thing: calm, compliant, will not leave.

scenes.title: A drop that missed
scenes.text: Supply crates half sunk in the mud. A company name stencilled on, painted out, and a second name painted over that.

scenes.title: Mira's field bench
scenes.text: Sample jars, each brighter than the last. In the margin of the log: it wants to be looked after. I am not sure that is a metaphor any more.

scenes.title: The count
scenes.text: Someone kept a tally on this wall. Days, then weeks. The marks stop, and under them one line: why would I go?

scenes.title: The long-range set
scenes.text: The outpost's radio, opened up with an axe. Whoever did it coiled the cables neatly afterwards.
